scope.description: A separate follow-up workflow to publish.yml, triggered only after it completes.

additionalPermissions.purpose: Read the triggering publish run's own jobs (to find the matched publish (<key>) job and its run_attempt) and, on the schema-3 replay path, that run's qualified-candidate-<key> artifact list and download.
additionalPermissions.note: This scope was added during the 2026-09-23 review rounds to make the workflow function at all (the GitHub Actions jobs/artifacts API requires it) and was not part of the original two-write-scope ask this decision's source quotes. It grants no write capability and cannot itself publish, push to main, or touch a registry credential. The owner has been separately asked to confirm it; until confirmed, treat it as a read-only addition awaiting explicit sign-off, not as covered by the original "approved" reply below.

constraints: Never pushes to the default branch (main) directly.
Only opens or updates pull requests carrying governance/release-publications/later/ evidence records.
publish.yml's own upload job (contents: read, id-token: write) is unchanged by this grant.

source: The owner replied "approved" to the coordinator's "Permission decision" ask about granting a separate follow-up workflow contents: write and pull-requests: write, with no publish credential, that never pushes to main and only opens evidence pull requests.
note: This decision is scoped to exactly the design described above: the two write scopes the source quotes. It does not authorize broadening this workflow's permissions, granting them to publish.yml itself, or granting them to any other workflow. Multiple independent blind reviews (security- and correctness-focused, 2026-09-23) subsequently required narrowing this workflow's trust boundary (trigger gating, provenance verification, branch-adoption checks) without changing the two write-scope grant itself; this decision covers that narrowed design unchanged. See additionalPermissions above for the one scope (actions: read) added since the original ask, which remains pending explicit owner confirmation.
